notes.title: Patch with bug fixes and user experience improvements
notes.content: [p]1. Added Lens Flares[/p][p]2. Fixed some dialogue sounds[/p][p]3. Fixed some music playback errors[/p][p]4. Added more in-game hints that are organically integrated into the gameplay, now you:[/p][p]4.1 Be sure to find the scanner in the Prologue[/p][p]4.2 Don't miss the garbage chute in Part 1[/p][p]5. Fixed some shortcomings in the plot forks in Part 1[/p][p]6. NEW PART 1 TRAILER CHECK IT OUT[/p][p]7. Fixed the translation of the notes[/p][p]8. Slightly fixed the behavior of the camera when changing poses, now it is more difficult to break it (why are you trying to break it? just play)[/p][p]9. Added an outline to the subtitles[/p][p]10. Fixed some physical contours of objects[/p][p]11. Fixed light leakage in the owner's apartment in Part 1[/p][p]12. Fixed a bug due to which some cutscenes could not be skipped[/p]

notes.title: Added a small portion of the next chapter of stories.
notes.content:
Hello!

Added Part 1 Demo is a short prologue to the first part of a large-scale horror-almanac Intown Nightmares, the main developer is taken away to the army and this game will be a kind of farewell letter for a year, but don't worry, he will definitely come back and the game will be good, we will finish this story and the whole game too, please wait.
